paragraphs.cn: 2026年7月8日，中国国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂出席国家科学技术奖励大会、中国科学院第二十一次院士大会、中国工程院第十七次院士大会和中国科学技术协会第十一次全国代表大会。习近平强调，要加快实现高水平科技自立自强，以科技创新支撑和引领中国式现代化。他指出，“十五五”时期（2026-2030年）是建设科技强国的关键攻关期，“我们必须抓住历史机遇，迎接时代挑战，加快实现高水平科技自立自强，稳步迈向2035年建成科技强国的目标。”

Xi and other Party and state leaders, together with the two top-award winners, presented certificates to representatives of recipients of other awards. Li Qiang presided over the meeting.
paragraphs.cn: 会上，习近平向2025年度国家最高科学技术奖获得者——中国科学院物理研究所研究员、中国工程院院士陈立泉，以及中国电子科技集团公司研究员、中国工程院院士贲德颁发奖章和证书，并与两位科学家握手表示祝贺。习近平等党和国家领导人同两位最高奖获得者一起，为其他获奖代表颁发证书。李强主持大会。

paragraphs.en: Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi and Li Xi attended the meeting. Ding Xuexiang announced the award decision. Xi noted that China is now accelerating its {{6}} from a global participant and contributor in science and technology to a pioneer and leader, and has become one of the countries with the fastest growing innovation {{9}}. Over the past two years, China has achieved a string of remarkable sci-tech {{7}}, including Chang'e-6 completing humanity's first-ever sample return from the moon's far side, smart robots and drones making strides in both R&D and industrial application, innovative drugs leaping from {{8}} and follow-on research to world-first development, as well as domestically-bred crop varieties covering over 95 percent of the country's farmland. But Xi also pointed out that China still faces gaps in original innovation capacity, an {{10}} talent structure, and inefficient use of science and technology investment, which demand serious attention and {{11}}.
paragraphs.cn: 赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、李希出席大会。丁薛祥宣读授奖决定。习近平指出，我国正加速从全球科技参与者和贡献者向引领者转变，已成为创新能力增长最快的国家之一。过去两年，我国取得了一系列重大科技突破，包括嫦娥六号完成人类首次月背采样返回，智能机器人和无人机在研发和产业化方面取得进展，创新药物从模仿和跟踪研究跃升至全球首创，以及国产农作物品种覆盖全国95%以上的耕地。但习近平也指出，我国在原始创新能力、人才结构失衡和科技投入效率等方面仍存在差距，需要高度重视并加以解决。

paragraphs.en: He stressed that the new round of sci-tech revolution and industrial transformation is {{12}} changing the way humanity produces and lives, as well as the landscape of global development. "We must adapt to the new situation and requirements, take more forceful measures to address the problems existing in China's sci-tech development, and make every effort to ensure the implementation of the various arrangements made by the Party Central Committee on sci-tech undertakings," he said. Xi called for further strengthening of {{13}} in sci-tech strategic planning, policies and measures, major tasks, research strength, resource platforms, and regional innovation. "We should improve the mechanisms for deploying and organizing major national sci-tech innovation tasks, and strengthen the self-sufficiency for sci-tech {{14}}," he said. Major projects should be planned {{15}} across frontier fields like AI, quantum tech and life sciences, in priority sectors such as integrated circuits and advanced manufacturing, as well as in strategic domains, including deep sea, deep space, and deep earth, he noted.
paragraphs.cn: 他强调，新一轮科技革命和产业变革正深刻改变人类生产生活方式和全球发展格局。“我们必须适应新形势新要求，采取更有力措施解决我国科技发展存在的问题，全力确保党中央关于科技事业各项部署落到实处。”习近平要求进一步加强科技战略规划、政策措施、重大任务、科研力量、资源平台和区域创新的统筹协调。“要完善国家重大科技创新任务部署和组织机制，加强科技基础设施的自给能力。”他指出，重大项目的规划应涵盖人工智能、量子技术和生命科学等前沿领域，集成电路和先进制造等优先领域，以及深海、深空和深地等战略领域。

paragraphs.en: Xi emphasized the need to promote the deep {{16}} of sci-tech innovation with industrial innovation, opening up channels for accelerating the transformation of sci-tech achievements into real productive forces. "Sci-tech innovation should highlight an application-oriented approach, while industrial innovation should raise scientific questions. We must strengthen the national technology {{17}} system, create diversified application scenarios and high-level industrial {{18}}, and facilitate the promotion, application and {{19}} upgrading of self-developed technologies and products," he said. Xi also called for improving the {{20}} property protection system and building a financial system {{21}} with sci-tech innovation. When speaking of cultivating young sci-tech talents, Xi pointed out that research should be integrated with education, and greater support should be provided to researchers to help them overcome practical challenges.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平强调，要推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，打通加速科技成果转化为现实生产力的通道。“科技创新要坚持应用导向，产业创新要提出科学问题。要加强国家技术转移体系建设，创造多元化应用场景和高水平产业集群，促进自主技术和产品的推广、应用和迭代升级。”习近平还要求完善知识产权保护体系，构建与科技创新相适应的金融体系。在谈到培养青年科技人才时，习近平指出，科研要与教育相结合，为科研人员克服实际困难提供更大支持。

paragraphs.en: Efforts should be made to identify and nurture the teenagers' interests, specialties, scientific {{22}} and experimental skills, inspiring more promising youth to pursue careers in science and technology, he said. Xi stressed the need to boost the effectiveness of innovation investment. During the 14th Five-Year Plan period (2021-2025), China's total R&D spending grew by an average of 10 percent annually, which was no small feat. "Yet in practice, problems such as wasteful spending and inefficient {{23}} in investment still persist to varying degrees," he noted, calling for improving systems and management to ensure that every penny is not only spent right but spent well to match greater investment with greater efficiency. He said that enterprises should be encouraged to increase their R&D spending, and broader social resources should be mobilized to support sci-tech innovation.

paragraphs.en: Xi pointed out that it is necessary to deepen reforms on sci-tech evaluation, making it a good "conductor's baton." Project reviews, institutional assessments, and talent evaluations should all be guided by innovation capability, quality, actual effect, and contribution. He stressed the need to strengthen {{24}} of sci-tech ethics and security. "Science and technology should pursue positive and ethical progress, maintain security and controllability, and deliver benefits to the people," he said. Ethical standards and guidelines for key areas should be clarified, and the assessment, monitoring and early warning, as well as emergency response of sci-tech security risks, should be enhanced, he added. paragraphs.cn: 习近平指出，要深化科技评价改革，使其成为好的“指挥棒”。项目评审、机构评估和人才评价都要以创新能力、质量、实效和贡献为导向。他强调要加强科技伦理和安全治理。“科技要追求积极向善的进步，保持安全可控，造福人民。”要明确重点领域的伦理标准和指南，加强科技安全风险的评估、监测预警和应急处置。习近平要求中国科学院和中国工程院引领全国科技界紧跟新科技革命步伐，攀登全球科学新高峰；同时要求中国科学技术协会全力服务科研人员、创新驱动发展、提升公众科学素养以及党和政府的科学决策。

paragraphs.en: Li Qiang pointed out that Xi's important speech fully affirmed the nation's major scientific achievements in recent years, analyzed the new situation facing sci-tech development and laid out clear requirements for implementing the Party Central Committee's plans for sci-tech development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. Wednesday's meeting honored 258 projects and 11 scientific and technological experts. Among them, 51 projects received the State Natural Science Award, 58 projects the State Technological Invention Award, and 149 projects the State Scientific and Technological Progress Award. In addition to the two recipients of the top award, nine foreign experts were conferred the China International Science and Technology Cooperation Award.
paragraphs.cn: 李强指出，习近平的重要讲话充分肯定了近年来我国取得的重大科技成就，分析了科技发展面临的新形势，并对落实党中央关于“十五五”时期科技发展的规划提出了明确要求。当天的会议表彰了258个项目和11位科技专家。其中，国家自然科学奖51项，国家技术发明奖58项，国家科学技术进步奖149项。除两位最高奖获得者外，还有9位外国专家获得中华人民共和国国际科学技术合作奖。

articles.title: From wildlife rescue to China's biodiversity conservation
articles.titleCn: 从野生动物救援到中国生物多样性保护
articles.summary: From wildlife rescue to China's biodiversity conservation
articles.summaryCn: 西宁野生动物园通过救援、康复和放归雪豹等珍稀动物，展示了中国在生物多样性保护方面的努力与成就。

paragraphs.en: "Only if we understand, will we care. Only if we care, will we help. Only if we help shall all be saved." The famous words of renowned {{0}} Jane Goodall greet visitors at Xining Wildlife Park. More than just a zoo, Xining Wildlife Park is also known as the Qinghai Wildlife Rescue and Breeding Center, an institution dedicated to wildlife rescue, {{1}}, breeding research and conservation education. Since 2010, it has rescued more than 2,700 wild animals from over 60 species, with around one-third successfully released back into the wild.
paragraphs.cn: “唯有了解，我们才会关心；唯有关心，我们才会行动；唯有行动，生命才有希望。”著名灵长类动物学家珍·古道尔的这句名言迎接着西宁野生动物园的游客。西宁野生动物园不仅仅是一座动物园，它也被称为青海野生动物救护繁育中心，是一个致力于野生动物救援、康复、繁育研究和保护教育的机构。自2010年以来，它已救助了来自60多个物种的2700多只野生动物，其中约三分之一成功放归野外。

paragraphs.en:
Among its best-known residents are four iconic highland {{2}} – the snow leopard, Eurasian lynx, Pallas's cat and Chinese mountain cat. China has made significant progress in marine ecological protection across the South China Sea in recent years, transforming once-barren reefs into thriving ecosystems through sustained conservation efforts, scientific innovation and robust governance.

Through innovative organic fertilization methods, the reef's sand salinity dropped from 1.38‰ to 0.443‰, boosting plant survival rates to over 90%.
Coral reef restoration
An aerial view of the Weizhou Island, south China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, March 20, 2026. 
Around Weizhou Island off the coast of south China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, a 2,000-square-meter restoration demonstration zone built by a research team from Guangxi University's School of Marine Sciences saw live coral coverage rise from approximately 5% to 20% in just three years.
"In 2023, with strong support from the Beihai municipal government and the Weizhou Island Management Committee, the team further deployed 1,520 artificial reefs and transplanted more than 80,000 coral colonies, restoring 450 mu (about 30 hectares) of sea area," said Huang Wen, an associate professor at Guangxi University's School of Marine Sciences. Coral species increased from 46 to 62, and the area has become the only part of China's coastal waters where large whales are regularly sighted.
Wildlife recovery
A green sea turtle in the sea. /South China Sea Institute of Oceanology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
In June, a scientific expedition team from the Chinese Academy of Sciences' South China Sea Institute of Oceanology discovered a large population of green sea turtles – a nationally protected wild animal – in the seagrass beds of Huangyan Dao's lagoon, with preliminary observations counting more than 50 individuals.
The discovery, made possible by drone-based survey technology, indicates that the lagoon has developed a mature coral reef-seagrass composite ecosystem, providing an ideal habitat for ecologically important marine species.
Technology at the forefront
Picture of mangroves took during the remote sensing monitoring mission. /South China Sea Bureau of the Ministry of Natural Resources
Advanced technology is enhancing the precision of conservation efforts.
In January, the South China Sea Bureau of the Ministry of Natural Resources completed its first comprehensive remote sensing monitoring mission for mangroves across the region. The mission successfully monitored over 20,000 mangrove patches, identified 39 sites of human disturbance, and assessed 174 restoration projects, securing two national invention patents in the process.
On Zhubi Reef, an ocean environment monitoring station now provides round-the-clock surveillance of surrounding waters, with water temperature, salinity and pH readings updated every 10 minutes.

珊瑚礁修复：2026年3月20日，中国南部广西壮族自治区的涠洲岛鸟瞰图。在广西壮族自治区沿海的涠洲岛周围，由广西大学海洋学院研究团队建立的一个2000平方米的修复示范区，在短短三年内，活珊瑚覆盖率从大约5%上升到20%。广西大学海洋学院副教授黄文说：“2023年，在北海市政府和涠洲岛管理委员会的大力支持下，该团队进一步部署了1520个人工礁，移植了超过8万株珊瑚，恢复了450亩（约30公顷）的海域。”珊瑚种类从46种增加到62种，该区域已成为中国沿海水域中唯一经常发现大型鲸鱼的地方。野生动物恢复：一只绿海龟在海中。

中国科学院南海海洋研究所：6月，中国科学院南海海洋研究所的一个科学考察队在黄岩岛泻湖的海草床中发现了一个大型绿海龟种群——这是一种国家保护的野生动物，初步观察统计超过50只。这一发现得益于无人机调查技术，表明泻湖已发展出成熟的珊瑚礁-海草复合生态系统，为生态重要的海洋物种提供了理想的栖息地。技术前沿：红树林遥感监测任务中的图片。自然资源部南海局：先进技术正在提高保护工作的精确度。1月，自然资源部南海局完成了该地区首次全面的红树林遥感监测任务。

该任务成功监测了超过2万片红树林，识别了39处人为干扰地点，评估了174个修复项目，并在此过程中获得了两项国家发明专利。在渚碧礁，一个海洋环境监测站现在对周围水域提供全天候监控，每10分钟更新一次水温、盐度和pH值读数。

, Updated 11:44, 15-Jul-2026This picture shows ships sailing near the Strait of Hormuz off the eastern coast of the United Arab Emirates at Khor Fakkan on July 13, 2026. 
US President Donald Trump resumed the naval blockade of Iranian ports on Tuesday and threatened new strikes on the country's power plants and bridges if Tehran refuses to return to talks.
The US also launched a new wave of strikes aimed at "continuing to degrade Iranian capabilities used to attack commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz," the US military said.
The moves mark a further escalation in the renewed confrontation between the US and Iran, which resumed hostilities last week and put a fragile June truce under mounting strain. Tehran says it has again shut the Strait of Hormuz, a key chokepoint for global energy trade.
"I'll save the energy targets for last, but ultimately we'll hit energy targets," Trump told Fox News in an interview that aired Tuesday night on "Special Report with Bret Baier."
"Next week comes the power plants, next week comes the bridges," Trump said, "unless they get to the table and negotiate."
Trump said US negotiators had contacted Iranian counterparts with a message that Tehran "better make a deal."
Iran, meanwhile, reported fresh attacks on US positions and facilities in Gulf countries. Its army said early on Wednesday that drones had been launched at US positions at Jordan's Azraq base.
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps separately said it struck weapons and storage facilities in Bahrain and Kuwait.
The latest exchange of attacks has deepened uncertainty over the future of a memorandum of understanding signed last month, which had raised hopes of a more durable end to the fighting. The war has spread beyond Iran's borders, drawn neighboring countries into the hostilities and disrupted international energy flows.
In southern Iran, authorities reported US attacks at several locations near the Strait of Hormuz. American projectiles struck an area around Bandar Abbas, the provincial governor's office told state media late on Tuesday. State news agency IRNA separately reported a strike near Sirik.
"If the US thinks that by tightening its measures against us, its military actions and its economic blockade, we will return to negotiations, it is making a mistake," Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said in an earlier interview with state television.
Roughly a fifth of global oil and gas shipments moved through the Strait of Hormuz each day before the war erupted in February, underscoring the wider economic stakes of the renewed fighting.
Trump had proposed on Monday imposing a 20% charge on ships using the waterway, prompting sharp criticism from the UN shipping agency and others. By Tuesday, he had dropped the proposal and said he would pursue investment agreements with Gulf countries instead, though he offered few details.
The reinstated US naval blockade, covering vessels traveling to and from Iranian ports and coastal areas, took effect at 8 p.m. GMT on Tuesday. The measure had been suspended in June.
Trump said vessels from other countries remained free to use the strait, with the restrictions applying to Iranian shipping. More than 20 US Navy warships and hundreds of military aircraft are now deployed across the region, according to the US military.
At home, the war has become increasingly politically costly for Trump as gasoline prices rise and November's congressional elections draw closer.
